entries.english:
Miscellaneous privileges and feudal matters of the Lords von Rosenberg (mostly certified copies).

Term: 1559, 1577, 1593, 1604, 1625 (1661).

Contains: 1. fols. 1–3, Emperor Ferdinand I’s privilege of red wax for the Lords von Rosenberg, 1559 (1661); 2. fols. 4–5, feudal letter for Waldmannshofen from Margrave Joachim Ernst von Brandenburg-Ansbach to Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg, 1604 (1661); 3. fols. 6–24, enfeoffment of the Lords von Rosenberg with their formerly Palatine quarter of Aub by the Bishop of Würzburg, 1625 (1661); 4. fols. 25–47, free passage between Württemberg and Rosenberg, 1593 (1661); 5. fols. 48–58, list of the dues and rents of the Corpus Christi vicariate at Röttingen in Waldmannshofen, 1577 (1661).

Extent: 1 volume, fols. 1–60.
